general.languageHint: Language of this device. Other devices keep their own choice.
general.editMode: You can change settings: Orbit runs on this machine.

general.configHint: Orbit keeps each feature in its own orbit.<feature>.json file on the machine running it.
general.noFiles: No configuration file has been created yet.

appearance.inUse: {{name}} is in use on this device

advanced.intro: Everything here is optional. The basics live under General and Appearance.

advanced.customizeViewOnly: Only available on the machine running Orbit.
advanced.viewingDistanceHint: How far people sit from the screen. Orbit makes text and charts bigger for screens seen from farther away. Applies to this device.
advanced.soundHint: Sound alerts of the wall opened in this browser.
advanced.soundOn: Play a sound when a monitor changes state
advanced.registryHint: Every setting Orbit has. Choose whether a change applies to this device only or to the whole workspace.
advanced.deviceHint: Theme, language, density, animation and viewing distance chosen on this browser.
